names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Ιουνίου, «Τατιανή η Πρεσβυτέρα του», with the rank word left off; the page's head calls her «Αγια Τατιανη η Πρεσβυτερα Του Μητροφανη».

death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγια Τατιανη η Πρεσβυτερα Του Μητροφανη (; - 1900)». The page gives no year of birth.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026). saint.gr makes her the wife of a priest of the Russian mission at Peking, so a Russian row is very likely to exist; it was not looked for and nothing is claimed about it.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Μητροφάνης Τσί-Σούνγκ και οι μαζί μ' αυτόν μαρτυρήσαντες: Τατιανή η Πρεσβυτέρα του …»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and dates her «(; - 1900)». The entry enumerates its members, so she is a folder of her own. The hymns on the shared page are the propers of Metrophanes and one collective hymn to the Chinese martyrs, which is taken on the company's folder; none of them names her, so this folder carries no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
